metaDescription: Container houses built in our Bengaluru and Greater Noida factories from Rs 2.93 lakh. Steel frame, glasswool insulation, six sizes, pan-India delivery.
opener: A container house from SAMAN is a factory-built steel home: a welded MS frame, corrugated MS outer walls, 75 mm mineral wool wall insulation and a 100 mm glasswool roof layer, finished inside and delivered ready to live in. Prices start at Rs 2,93,440 ex-GST for the 20x8 ft unit and run to Rs 7,36,320 for the 40x12 ft home, across six standard sizes. This page covers the full range; the prefab, luxury, shipping-form and affordable pages each own one build style, and every one is made in our own Bengaluru and Greater Noida works.
descriptionHtml:
Every container house on this page is newly fabricated in container form at our own works; a converted used ISO container is available only as a separately quoted option.
